title: docs_publisher args

docs_root_folder.description: The folder inside the docs repository that holds the published docs.

docs_branch.description: The branch of the docs repository to publish to.

docs_repository.description: The docs repository (org/repo) that the docs are published to.

source_branch.description: The branch of the source repository that pushes are published from, and that the entries file is read from.

docs_app_id_variable.description: The name of the repository variable that holds the GitHub App id used to push to the docs repository.

docs_app_key_secret.description: The name of the repository secret that holds the GitHub App private key used to push to the docs repository.

description: Publishes a repository's docs into a docs repository, the one central repository where the documentation of every repo that installs this feature is gathered. A release writes a new version folder, a push to the source branch refreshes the docs that follow that branch, and a pull request receives a comment that lists what it would publish or delete. The work is done by the Publisher action, so this feature installs a workflow that calls it, a starter entries file, and this README.
